_doc: Every job in Wayfare County (docs/EXPANSION-1.md 'Jobs'). A level unlocks when the one before it has been done once. `pay` is per step (steps) or per run; `hidden` jobs show obscured in the Jobs checklist until `reveal` happens (an achievement id or 'found' = reach the job's place). Upgrades are bought once, kept forever, and change how the job plays. `vehicles` = the vehicles the job is done with (any one of them).

jobs.name: Farming
jobs.blurb: Cut the crop, plant it again, water it, and repeat. Every step pays. Sell the harvest at the market.
jobs._doc: M6 (js/game/jobs/farming.js). steps = gold per batch of `batch` field cells (4 x 4 m) cut / planted / watered; selling pays deliver_per_unit per cell of crop plus deliver_per_km per cell per km carried. level.fields = how many fields that level opens (nearest the farm yard first); level.need = the goal the referee checks (farming.js goalMet); level.pay = the bonus when the goal is first met.

jobs.name: Firefighting
jobs.where: Fire stations in Marrow Flats and Port Lindell
jobs.blurb: Something is burning. Drive there, spray it out. Pay grows with the distance and how bad the fire got.
jobs._doc: M7 (js/game/jobs/fire.js). A fire's severity (1-10) climbs one step every 45 s nobody sprays it; grass fires spread. Water from a fire truck's cannon that lands in it puts it out; pay = pay.base + km from the nearest fire station x pay.per_km + the highest severity it reached x pay.per_severity, to everyone who sprayed it, everyone in their trucks and anyone within 30 m. level.need = the goal (fire.js fireMeets): kind, maxR (its radius when it went out), minSev (level 5's fire starts at that severity). level.pay = the bonus when it is first met. level.kinds = the fires a call may be once every level is done.

jobs.name: Ambulance
jobs.where: Hospitals in Port Lindell and Highgate
jobs.blurb: Pick someone up and get them to hospital. Quick pays more. Gentle driving pays a bonus.
jobs._doc: M7 (js/game/jobs/ambulance.js). Load a patient into an ambulance or the helicopter (stop beside them; stay at the wheel or hold E beside them), drop them at a hospital. pay = pay.base + km (patient -> hospital) x pay.per_km, +25% when quick, + pay.gentle_bonus x that x (1 - hard bumps / 3). level.need (ambulance.js ambMeets): gentle (most hard bumps allowed), spot (crash / farm / hiker / gorge), by (the vehicle kind). level.spots = where a call may be.

jobs.name: Highway Patrol
jobs.blurb: A runaway car is speeding through the county. Catch it and bump it to a stop.
jobs._doc: M7 (js/game/jobs/patrol.js). A runaway car drives a county road; hits from a patrol car or motorcycle with its siren on fill its stop meter. pay = pay.base + pay.per_speed x every second under 120 the chase took, to everyone who hit it, their passengers and anyone within 30 m. level.need (patrol.js patrolMeets): route (vale / mountain / highway), convoy (cars in one chase), fast (a runaway 30% faster).

jobs.name: Tow Truck
jobs.blurb: Wrecks and broken-down cars all over the county. Hook them up and bring them to the yard.
jobs._doc: M7 (js/game/jobs/tow.js). Back the tow truck up to a wreck's front, T to lift it (hold T further off to winch it in), drop it in a tow yard. pay = pay.base + km (wreck -> yard) x pay.per_km. level.need.spot: shoulder / ditch / cliff / heavy (a broken-down semi: the tow truck crawls with it unless you have the Heavy hitch).

jobs.name: Hauling
jobs.blurb: Cargo between the cities. Bigger loads, longer roads, better pay. Arrive with the cargo in one piece.
jobs._doc: M7 (js/game/jobs/haul.js). Stop in a depot yard with the right rig to load: Parcel Van = parcels to stops in that town; semi + box trailer (or the Trailhauler) = to another town's depot; semi + tanker = to Highgate; semi + flatbed = to the Skyreach launch site. pay = (pay.base + km x pay.per_km + tonnes x pay.per_tonne) x (0.6 + 0.4 x condition) (x1.3 on a long haul). level.need: cargo (parcels / box / tanker / machine / rocket).

jobs.name: Rustwild Raids
jobs.blurb: Raider camps hold the badlands. Clear them out with a weapons vehicle. They come back.
jobs._doc: M8 (js/game/jobs/combat.js, js/game/combat.js, js/game/combat-data.js). A camp is cleared when every raider AND its generator are down; it pays pay.base + pay.per_enemy per defender (+ pay.fortress for the fortress) to everyone who hit it in the last 3 minutes, everyone riding with them, and anyone within 30 m of the last kill — each the whole amount. Camps come back 4 minutes later. level.need = the goal the referee checks (combat.js goalMet): clears (+ within s), clean (no wreck in that fight), camp, distinct (+ within s). level.pay = the bonus when it is first met.

jobs.name: Skydiving
jobs.blurb: Jump from the cargo plane, fall, open your parachute and land on the target.
jobs._doc: M9 (js/game/jobs/skydive.js, js/game/sky.js). Every safe landing (under 9 m/s) pays pay.base; a parachute landing inside the 30 m target ring adds up to pay.target_bonus (more the closer, half again for a bullseye within 5 m); a glider landed on Highgate Plateau adds target_bonus. level.need = the goal the referee checks (sky.js landingMeets); level.pay = the bonus when it is first met.

jobs.name: Survey
jobs.blurb: Buy a survey kit at a Supply store, carry its crate to a spot that suits it, set it up, then drive back to the Survey Office to report.
jobs._doc: M10 (js/game/jobs/survey.js, pure rules js/game/survey.js, kits js/game/survey-kits.js). A kit set up at a good spot pays at the Survey Office: (kit.pay.base + kit.pay.per_km x km from the office) x (0.75 + 0.5 x spot quality), once per set-up kit. level.need = { kits: { <kitId>: n }, apart? } counted over the player's REPORTED kits still standing; level.pay = the bonus when it is first met (at the office).

jobs.name: Moon Work
jobs.blurb: Sample runs, crater jumps, supply runs to Farside and survey kits on the Moon — all in the Crater Crawler.
jobs._doc: M12 (js/game/jobs/moon.js). Samples: (pay.sample + km x pay.per_km) x rarity (common 1, uncommon 1.6, rare 2.6 = a steep crater floor), km = site to the Sample Drop. Jumps: (jump.base + air s x jump.per_s + m x jump.per_m) x 1.5 upright + jump.ring in the landing ring; the same ramp within a minute pays half. Crates: (pay.crate + km x pay.crate_per_km) each. level.need: samples / rare / jump (m) / ring / crates + to (farside | greywatch) + round (a clean round trip) / kit (a survey kit set up on the Moon).
